title: Slot-affinity headroom autoscaler with graceful shedding and cost cap
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and implement a slot-affinity aware autoscaling policy for Dedicated fleets that targets per-slot throughput and token concurrency instead of only per-replica metrics. The goal is to provide predictable throughput guarantees while minimizing cost by packing tenant requests into stable 'slots' with KV-cache affinity, and to include a graceful shedding path when hard safety limits are reached. This ticket specifies target metrics, the scaling algorithm (slot-aware leaky-integrator with derivative damping), safety limits (max scale rate, min reserved replicas, emergency shred thresholds), telemetry, and rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Autoscaler exposes new target metrics: slot_token_rate (tokens/s/slot), slot_concurrency (active requests/slot), kv_affinity_score
Scaling decisions use slot-based aggregation and do not violate max_scale_delta_per_minute (default 20 replicas/min)
Graceful shedding triggers at configured overload_ratio with prioritized tenant shedding list and emits "shed_event" metrics
End-to-end smoke: under synthetic mixed workload, p95 latency stays within SLA for high-priority tenants while lower-priority tenants are shed when capacity exhausted
Unit and integration tests for algorithm, plus a canary rollout shows no availability regression in staging
technical_notes: Algorithm: windowed leaky-integrator per-slot that computes desired_slot_count = EWMA(traffic_token_rate) / target_tokens_per_slot with derivative damping and a sigmoid-based cap to avoid step-churn
Slot affinity: prefer hot-KV-affinity placements by scoring candidate replicas with kv_affinity_score and only move slots if score delta > move_cost_threshold
Safety fences: enforce min_replicas_per_fleet, max_scale_delta_per_minute, and max_absolute_replicas; use cool_down_window after any scaling event

Shedding: two-stage approach: 1) soft: prioritize background tenants and apply 429 backpressure plus dequeue delay; 2) hard: implement token-based admission controller that returns a structured shed response and logs shed_event with reason and tenant id
Cost cap: incorporate a cost_budget signal; when spend_rate > budget_rate trigger progressive tightening of slot targets until spend within limit
Rollbacks: automatic rollback on sudden latency regression > 25% p95 sustained for 3 minutes
risks: Slot moves may cause KV cache invalidations that increase latency if move thresholds are too low
Shedding logic could impact enterprise customers if tenant priority mapping is incorrect
Complexity of per-slot bookkeeping increases memory/CPU on scheduler; may require opt-in per-tenant initially
comments: 2026-03-02 - Asha Patel: Drafted initial design; propose slot_token_rate as canonical target for dedicated tenants with steady streaming workloads.
2026-03-04 - Marco Liang: Reviewed algorithm; suggested adding derivative damping to reduce oscillation when traffic bursts subside. Will prototype in sim harness.
2026-03-06 - SRE (Jamie Ortiz): Flagged risk: slot moves can amplify tail latency. Suggest adding a move_cost_threshold and measuring kv_cache_miss delta in canary.
2026-03-08 - Product (Rana Singh): Confirmed priority mapping strategy: org-level -> app-level -> route-level fallback. High-priority tenants default to 'reserved' category.
2026-03-10 - Marco Liang: Prototype sim run shows 35% cost savings for bursty multi-tenant mix vs naive replica-based autoscaler, p95 regressions within acceptable range for reserved tenants.
2026-03-12 - Asha Patel: Added shedding strategy and cost-cap integration. Next: implement canary controller and create staging dashboards.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Feature flagged opt-in per-tenant in staging, 1-week soak with synthetic traces
Phase 2: Canary in region-us-east with 5% of Dedicated fleets for non-enterprise tenants, monitor shedding events and kv_cache_miss
Phase 3: Expand to 25% with tenant-priority enforcement and cost cap enabled
Phase 4: Gradual GA with documentation and runbook; provide disable toggle and immediate rollback path
